sentences.en: Today I want to talk about challenging yourself, stepping out of your comfort zone and being the dumbest person in the room. Because... it's intimidating to be surrounded by people who are.
sentences.tc: 今天我想談談挑戰自己，走出舒適圈，成為房間裡最愚蠢的人。因為……被這樣的人包圍是令人生畏的。

sentences.en: Smarter than you or better than you.
sentences.tc: 比你聰明或比你更好。

sentences.en: Today I went to a dance class. I've always loved to dance since.
sentences.tc: 今天我去上舞蹈課。從那時起我就一直喜歡跳舞。

sentences.en: I was a little girl, but it's been AGES since the last time.
sentences.tc: 我還是個小女孩，但距離上次已經好幾年了。

sentences.en: I went to a dance class. And I went to ballet or contemporary or kumbia dance classes.
sentences.tc: 我去上舞蹈課。我還參加了芭蕾舞、現代舞或昆比亞舞蹈課程。

sentences.en: Today I went to a different dance class and all the girls there were so good. Right away there were so many steps that.
sentences.tc: 今天我去了一個不同的舞蹈班，那裡的所有女孩都很棒。馬上就有這麼多步驟了。

sentences.en: I was having trouble memorizing. Meanwhile, the other girls were remembering each step as.
sentences.tc: 我的記憶力很差。與此同時，其他女孩正在記住每一步。

sentences.en: We learned them. Instantly.
sentences.tc: 我們學習了他們。即刻。

sentences.en: They had so much FLOW and rhythm and such a good memory.
sentences.tc: 他們有如此多的流動性和節奏以及如此好的記憶力。

sentences.en: I thought I don't stand a chance against them. And I was almost certain.
sentences.tc: 我以為我沒有機會對抗他們。我幾乎可以肯定。

sentences.en: I worked a lot harder than anyone else to remember the choreography.
sentences.tc: 我比任何人都更努力地記住編舞。

sentences.en: I know this because everybody danced with such free movements. Like.
sentences.tc: 我知道這一點是因為每個人都以如此自由的動作跳舞。喜歡。

sentences.en: They weren't even trying... Meanwhile, I was just stumbling, forgetting every step.
sentences.tc: 他們甚至沒有嘗試……同時，我只是跌跌撞撞，忘記了每一步。

sentences.en: Then I realized I wasn't dancing AGAINST them. You are almost never really going against someone else.
sentences.tc: 然後我意識到我跳舞並不是反對他們。你幾乎從來不會真正與別人為敵。

sentences.en: I mean, you can choose to go against someone or you can choose to learn from them. And once.
sentences.tc: 我的意思是，你可以選擇反對某人，也可以選擇向他們學習。還有一次。

sentences.en: I set my mindset to learning from them instead of competing with them, and once.
sentences.tc: 我的心態是向他們學習，而不是與他們競爭，而且一次。

sentences.en: I pushed through all of my insecurities, feelings of self-consciousness, embarrassment and intimidation.
sentences.tc: 我克服了所有的不安全感、難為情、尷尬和恐嚇感。

sentences.en: Then I eventually memorized the choreography. I got there with much more work than the other girls.
sentences.tc: 後來我終於記住舞蹈編排了。我到達那裡比其他女孩做更多的工作。

sentences.en: I got there. And I got there because I didn't give up.
sentences.tc: 我到了那裡。我到達那裡是因為我沒有放棄。

sentences.en: I didn't quit. I got there because despite all my insecurities, I kept going.
sentences.tc: 我沒有放棄。我到達那裡是因為儘管我充滿了不安全感，但我仍然繼續前進。

sentences.en: I didn't give up. I felt so proud of myself after. Even.
sentences.tc: 我沒有放棄。之後我為自己感到非常驕傲。甚至。
